title: Figure 7. Omni-Directional Nature of the HFGW Radiation Pattern
description: Two 3D wireframe renderings of a two-lobed gravitational wave radiation pattern: the left shows the lobes along a vertical axis labeled "GWs"; the right shows the lobes inside a spherical mesh with axis labels and Δf annotations. Caption: "Figure 7. Omni-Directional Nature of the HFGW Radiation Pattern". Text discusses concentric IR ring stacks and flux calculations for a cylindrical HFGW generator.
